headline: Passage Surges as Contested Fronts Cool
war_summary: Callahan’s Passage has become the chief fresh flashpoint since the last edition, rising to 32 ownership events, with 12 recorded in the latest two hours and fighting accelerating on both casualty ledgers; The Latch accounts for 21 of the day’s actions. Fisherman’s Row has edged up to 48 events, though only two are recent, with Eidolo and Dankana Post still the busiest named bases. Weathered Expanse remains sharply contested at 44 events and five recent actions, while Stlican Shelf stands at 41 with one late movement; Breaker Town and Fort Hoarfrost dominate that sector’s record. Nevish Line has nine events and a seven-base Warden, one-base Colonial split, but no fresh action in the latest two hours. Mooring County likewise shows six events and no immediate ownership movement, despite accelerating casualties and a twelve-base Warden hold. Linn Mercy has cooled to five events and remains quiet at the base level. Elsewhere, most regions report no ownership changes, leaving the next day’s clearest strategic uncertainty concentrated in the four heavily contested sectors.
